 Clash of Clans codes
 Here are the Clash of Clans Creator Boost codes, Supercell Store reward links and the most reliable ways to earn free gems as of November 2026.
 Source: Clash of Clans 
 By Yasemin Yaman 
 November 1, 2026 
 Updated November 1, 2026 
 Strengthening your Town Hall defenses and speeding up your army takes resources, and many chiefs turn to the internet hoping to find a working promo code. Supercell’s long-running strategy hit Clash of Clans handles codes differently from most mobile games, though. Below you’ll find the codes and reward links that work this month, along with a few facts worth knowing before you start searching.
 Last updated: November 1, 2026
 Related story

 November 1, 2026 
 Clash of Clans codes - November 2026
 1 active code Last checked Nov 1, 2026 Code Reward 
 Reward Links Copy Resources or items delivered straight to your village 
 Plenty of websites share the following codes as “Clash of Clans Store codes,” but they actually belong to Clash Royale:
 "ROYALEAFFAIR, FIREANDICE!!, TRUSTYTURRET, WHENHOGSFLY!, REINABARRIGA"
 If you play both games, you can redeem them for Clash Royale through the Supercell Store. They won’t give you anything in Clash of Clans.
 How to redeem a code in the Supercell Store
 Open the Supercell Store in your browser.
 Log in with the Supercell ID linked to your Clash of Clans account.
 Pick Clash of Clans from the list of Supercell games.
 Scroll down to the “Redeem Store Code” field and enter the code.
 Confirm, and the rewards will be added to your in-game account.
 Clash of Clans reward links
 Besides store codes, Supercell occasionally shares special reward links. Here is the active one:
 Reward link : 50K gold
 How to catch free rewards in November
 In-game events: Check the “Events” tab in the bottom right every day. Winter season tasks are currently handing out free Magic Books.
 QR codes: During official YouTube broadcasts, Supercell sometimes shows QR codes on screen. Keep an eye on the clan war finals streams this month.
 Clash of Clans creator codes
 Creator codes don’t give you items directly. Instead, a small share of your in-game purchases goes to the content creator you choose. Each code stays active for about a week, so if you want to keep supporting the same creator, you’ll need to enter their name again once it expires.
 Akari Gaming: akari
 Alvaro845: Alvaro845
 Anikilo: anikilo
 Anon Moose: zmot
 Ark: ark
 Artube Clash: artube
 Judo Sloth Gaming: judo
 iTzu: itzu
 How to enter a creator code
 Tap the Settings (gear) icon in the bottom right of your village.
 Select “More Settings.”
 Scroll to the bottom of the page.
 Find the “Creator Boost” section and tap “Enter Code.”
 Type one of the codes above (for example, judo) and confirm.
 Keep in mind that the code resets every 7 days, so you’ll need to enter it again after that.
 How to farm gems without codes
 Rather than hunting for codes, these are the most reliable ways to earn gems this month:
 Clearing obstacles: The snowy trees that come with the winter theme drop a good number of gems when you remove them.
 Clan Games: Clan Games start in the last week of the month. Completing them lets you pick 50 to 100 gems along with magic items.
